notes.text: The passage calls him Rabbi Yochanan ben Gudgada. Its two versions make the boys sons of either his daughter or his sister. [Heilprin’s Gudgada notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=838&lang=en) gives the spelling גודגדא, whereas the body of Hyman’s notice uses גודגדה.
